text:
Situation: Warfarin sodium is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 272 tablets of the 6 mg presentation (26 days on hand). Corvale General holds 189 tablets of the 6 mg presentation (18.8 days) and 266 tablets of the 2 mg presentation (24.9 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 18 tablets of the 6 mg presentation (7 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include warfarin sodium as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers 7 to 26 days across sites. No FDA shortage listing exists. Alternate manufacturers Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, Coupler LLC, Exelan Pharmaceuticals Inc., Sun Pharmaceutical Industries, Inc., and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. are not on FDA's shortage list today, but their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, Coupler LLC, Exelan Pharmaceuticals Inc., Sun Pharmaceutical Industries, Inc., and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. to build safety stock; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to monitor FDA's shortage list weekly for any new listing; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to coordinate inter-site transfer from Corvale East and Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside to extend Lakeside coverage; requires Pharmacy Director and Operations Manager approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
